children: may retest a resistance at $2.9705 per lb, a break above which could lead to a gain into the $3.0110 to $3.0365 range.
A corrective wave cycle from $3.1820 seems to have completed, as suggested by its wave mode and the strong bounce from $2.8080.

A retracement analysis on the cycle reveals a target zone of $2.9950 to $3.0390, formed by the 50% and the 61.8% levels. A projection analysis on a wave c from $2.8635 marks a more fine-tuned range of $3.0110 to $3.0365, formed by the 138.2% and the 161.8% levels.
A break below $2.9045 could trigger a fall to $2.8635.
* The coffee report is published twice a week on Tuesday and Thursday.
